features: Adds a bell beside every live price for creating a one-shot Telegram price alert.
Automatically decides ABOVE/BELOW direction from the current price and the target price.
Stores active alerts in R2 so the bell state is shared across devices.
While monitor.html is open, the Worker checks active alerts every 10 seconds; an optional Cloudflare every-minute cron keeps alerts working when the page is closed.
On a successful Telegram send, the triggered alert is automatically deleted.
Telegram message format is: SYMBOL   觸發TARGET followed by Taiwan time.
